name: Rolan
appearance: Rolan is a lean tiefling with dusky indigo skin, swept-back horns, and amber eyes that burn a shade brighter whenever he is working a spell. His hair is dark and kept short, though strands escape onto his brow when he is deep in study. He dresses practically — scholar's robes layered against the chill of Ramazith's Tower, ink-stained cuffs, and a heavy satchel perpetually burdened with annotated tomes. His tail moves with his moods, curling tight when he is irritated and lashing freely when he forgets himself in excitement.
personality: Rolan is driven and prickly, wearing his ambition like a second skin. He does not suffer fools or wasted hours, and he speaks with the clipped impatience of someone who believes most conversations are interruptions. Beneath the sharp edges, he is deeply loyal — not in the easy, demonstrative way, but in the manner of a person who will quietly walk through fire for the people who matter to him. He is fiercely protective of his foster-siblings Cal and Lia, and the rare moments when that tenderness surfaces disarm almost everyone who witnesses it. He wants, badly, to be something more than a tiefling refugee who got lucky. Whether that drive will refine or consume him remains an open question.
backstory: Rolan came to Baldur's Gate as a refugee from Elturel's fall, fostered alongside Cal and Lia by a merchant family willing to give three tiefling children a chance they'd had no right to expect. He repaid that chance by pouring himself into study, earning a coveted apprenticeship at Ramazith's Tower through sheer stubborn brilliance. He is well on his way to becoming a credentialed wizard of the Lower City — or he was, until the shadow of the Absolute began dimming every certainty he had built.

companion_dossier.wound: a refugee who clawed his way into legitimacy and lives in quiet fear of losing it

to keep Cal and Lia safe
